name: Storsjöodjuret
body:
STORSJÖODJURET
CR 11

This mighty black-scaled water serpent has a light-scaled underbelly and fins running down its back, with a pair of short swimming arms with webbed claws. Its head, incongruously, resembles that of an oversized lynx.

XP 13,200
N Huge magical beast (aquatic, water)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, true seeing; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+6 Dex, +8 natural, –2 size)
hp 175 (14d10+98)
Fort +16, Ref +15, Will +8; SR 16 (26 vs. divinations); Resist cold 10

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee bite +20 (4d8+8 plus grab), tail slap +18 (4d6+4)
Ranged water jet +19 (2d8+8 plus trip)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with tail slap)
Special Attacks swallow whole (3d6+12 acid damage, AC 16, 14 hp
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 14th; concentration +17)

Constant—true seeing
At will—invisibility
3/day—expeditious retreat
1/day—acidic spray (DC 18), confusion (DC 17), freedom of movement, meld into stone

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 22, Con 24, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 16
Base Atk +14; CMB +24 (+28 to grapple); CMD 40
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth), Weapon Focus (water jet)
Skills Perception +17, Stealth +11 (+21 in water), Swim +16; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception, +10 Stealth in water

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Water Jet (Ex)

A storsjöodjuret can spit a jet of pressurized water and acid as a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 60 feet that deals 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage. It can also use the jet to make a ranged combat maneuver check to bull rush or trip a creature. The creature hit takes 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns for 4 rounds or until it neutralizes the acid.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold lakes
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard

These mighty serpents lives deep beneath the surface of alpine lakes, with heads resembling land animals like lynxes or wild dogs and often with a horse-like mane, a curious contrast to its dark grayish-brown scaly body that undulates as it swims. A storsjöodjuret is about 30 feet long and weighs about 2,000 pounds.

Reports of strange visions and events tend to surround any lake containing a storsjöodjuret. Runestones are believed to attract the creature, such that by placing a powerful runestone in a lake, one can keep the storsjöodjuret bound to that lake and not allow it to leave.

Many report seeing the elusive creature from a distance or for a fleeting moments, but few meeting one up close live to tell the tale, and often their bodies are never found. Locals are always sure a storsjöodjuret is there and often know people who have been lost to its jaws, yet organized searches—even with magic—always seem to wind up empty.
